title: Steam Wishlist-to-Play Conversion
dataSources: Steam activity and achievements (`steam:activity`), Chess.com games (`chesscom:game`), online-go matches (`ogs:game`), and poker home-game hands or settlements (`pokerhome:session`).
app: Gaming and play telemetry from Steam, Chess.com, Online-Go servers, and poker home-game logs sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and export files.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=steam:activity
| search genre=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count(eval(wishlist_state="wishlisted")) as wishlisted count(eval(first_played="true")) as played_from_wishlist by _time genre
| sort - _time
description: Tracks wishlist conversion to play over time and breaks it out by genre.
value: Wishlist conversion shows whether sales watching is turning into real play or just expanding the backlog.
implementation: Send wishlist conversion to play events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of wishlist conversion to play by genre.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers how wishlist conversion to play changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
